news.title: China's Retirement Reform and the 2035 Statutory Working-Age Window: Buying Time amid Demographic Decline and AI-Driven Change
news.summary_en: Using a monthly birth-cohort simulation, the author estimates that China’s 2025 retirement reform keeps about 48 million additional people below statutory retirement ages in 2035, delaying the working-age decline without reversing population aging.

news.title: Interpreting Dual-Use Biology Benchmarks for Frontier AI: Measurement, Saturation, and Generational Analysis
news.summary_en: The authors find that many artificial intelligence (AI) benchmark tasks are no longer informative, but a frontier of difficult tasks remains so, with recent gains concentrated on difficult tasks theorized to be relevant to real-world risk.

news.title: Public Benefits Are a Hidden Engine of College Completion
news.summary_en: It's often short-run financial constraints—not enough money to cover rent or food while also paying for school—that keep young adults out of the classroom. Public benefits relieve enough pressure to make enrollment possible. Once enrolled, benefits also help students stay.

news.title: Can AI Change How We Deal with Disasters?
news.summary_en: How might AI tools help emergency management professionals save lives, protect property, and reduce harm to communities?

news.title: AI and the Future of Emergency Management: Market Supply and Adoption Pathways
news.summary_en: In this report, the authors present the results of a landscape assessment of artificial intelligence–enabled products that are available to support the work of emergency management across the United States.

news.title: Secure Inference Data Centers: A Vertically Integrated Strategy for Security Engineering
news.summary_en: This report describes the deployment of secure inference data centers (SIDCs)—purpose-built facilities designed to protect artificial intelligence models from advanced nation-state adversaries. SIDCs can be built today with proven technologies.
